title: BEAST MASTERY HUNTER

source.author: Mobalytics
source.name: Mobalytics WoW Forever · Hunter Leveling Guide (Level 1-30)

headline: Tame a beast at level 10, send it in and shoot from range; Summon Hawk adds more companions.

build.early: You cannot Tame Beast until level 10 and become much stronger once a pet is by your side. Visit the Hunter trainer at levels 10, 18 and 26 for Tame Beast, Multi-Shot and Rapid Fire.

why.Ferocity: More damage for your pet and Hawks.

core.t: The foundation of your damage; keep it running.
After your next Auto Shot; hold it in groups until the tank has threat.
Shares its cooldown with Summon Hawk.
Use it twice on longer fights.
Finish enemies that reach you with melee swings.

items.t: put it up, then send your beast in
send it in next, again if the fight is long
or Multi-Shot after your next Auto Shot
if you pull threat; Mongoose Bite on long fights
level 30: pet opens with it for threat

notes: Bring plenty of ammo when questing or entering dungeons.
Tame a boar early (its Charge builds threat and it is not a picky eater), then a Tallstrider for Dust Cloud armor penetration.
Kite enemies you pull off your pet: shoot, move a little, repeat.
Summon Hawk shares a cooldown with Arcane Shot. If it underwhelms, or a fight is nearly over, use Arcane Shot instead.

stats.t: Attack Power and critical strike chance. Look for it first.

gear: Take items with Agility first and the other stats when they show up.
Keep your bow or gun upgraded: ranged weapon damage is your main source of damage.
dungeon_tips: A tank holds threat, so you can use Rapid Fire with less worry about pulling aggro.
Keep Hunter's Mark on the main target and let the tank get threat before Multi-Shot.
Explosive Trap and Frost Trap deal big area damage or slow a group so the tank can kite.

alliance.note: Probably the best Alliance race to 30: Mace Specialization, Stoneform, Big Game Hunter (extra damage to beasts).
Elune's Light gives 10% crit for 15s; passive speed and dodge; Wisp Spirit helps after death.

horde.note: 5% more damage to beasts, Berserking, Rapid Regeneration and Regeneration: four helpful buffs for leveling.

races.pick: Dwarf or Night Elf for the Alliance, Troll for the Horde.

trainers: Visit the Hunter trainer at levels 10, 18 and 26 for Tame Beast, Multi-Shot and Rapid Fire.
